input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects New York law (with CISG expressly excluded) and Section 28.2 confers exclusive jurisdiction on the state and federal courts in New York County, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and a venue-objection waiver. That matches the preferred position exactly; there is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document, so no foreign seat concern. The mutual carve-out in 28.2 for temporary injunctive relief to protect confidential information or IP and the non-blocking executive escalation in 28.3 (which expressly does not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings) are standard and reciprocal, and do not displace New York law or venue. No redline required.
